captions.linkedin:
One factor is fragile. Anyone running pure value got buried from 2018 to 2020. Anyone running pure momentum got buried in the 2009 reversal. Anyone running pure trend got carried out in 2011 to 2013.

The paper that fixes this isn't new. Asness, Moskowitz & Pedersen (2013) showed value and momentum are negatively correlated across 8 markets. Koijen et al. (2018) showed carry is robust across asset classes and not subsumed by known factors. Hurst, Ooi & Pedersen (2017) showed trend keeps its crisis alpha.

Combine the four. Equal-risk weight them. Cap leverage.

🔹 TREND SLEEVE, time-series momentum multi-horizon
🔹 CARRY SLEEVE, interest, term spread, basis, roll-down
🔹 VALUE / MOMENTUM, negatively correlated long-horizon edge
🔹 ERC WEIGHTING, equal risk contribution across sleeves
🔹 VOL TARGETING at three layers: instrument, sleeve, portfolio
🔹 MONTHLY REBALANCE with daily intra-month risk management

2018 to 2020 cut blended returns. Correlations spiked in the crisis. No free lunch is fully free.

Asness-Moskowitz-Pedersen, Koijen et al., Hurst-Ooi-Pedersen papers; educational only.
